full.desc: Full sharing: they can see your birth date and time, plus all your charts and your pair reading.
full.name: Share everything

resultsOnly.desc: Results only: they see your charts and your pair reading, but not your birth date, time or place.
resultsOnly.name: Share chart results only

thisSynastryOnly.desc: This pair reading only: your details are used for this one pair reading with them and appear nowhere else in their app.
thisSynastryOnly.name: Only for this synastry

invite.header: {inviter} invited you to look at your relationship map together
invite.intro: It takes a minute and no account. You decide how much to share, and you can withdraw any time.
invite.consent: I agree that Armilla uses my birth details to calculate charts and our synastry for {inviter}, at the level chosen above.
invite.privacy: Your birth details are stored encrypted; they only see what you allow.

done.title: Done. You can withdraw any time with the same link.
done.app: You can also get the app and look at your own map.

revoke.confirm: Your birth details and the charts made from them will be deleted within 24 hours.
revoke.done: Withdrawn. Your details will be deleted within 24 hours.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Ask the person who invited you for a new link.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this invitation
notFound.body: The link may be incomplete. Check it, or ask them to send it again.

invite.error: The invitation can't be opened right now. Please try again later.
invite.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a little while.
invite.keepCopy: Also keep these details for me: sign up within 30 days to see your own map straight away. Otherwise they are deleted automatically.

clip.noLink: Open this from an invitation link.

join.confirm: Join {owner}’s Family plan. Your profiles, life events, journal and conversations stay visible only to you.
join.title: Join a Family plan
join.confirmGeneric: Joining shares the Family membership. Your profiles, life events, journal and conversations stay visible only to you.
join.ownSub: Your own subscription keeps renewing after you join — you can cancel it in {store}.

yearOnly.note: Just the birth year is enough to start. Parts that need the date and time are shown dashed and recalculate once you add them.

date.label: Date of birth
date.leapHint: Only if that year really has this leap month — otherwise you’ll see a ‘date does not exist’ message.
date.ganZhiHint: Looks up the Gregorian date from the four pillars (1900–2100). With an hour pillar, the time is the middle of that double-hour.
date.candidates: {count, plural, =0 {No matching date} one {# date found — pick it} other {# dates found — pick one}}
date.pillarsRequired: Find and choose a matching date first.

notes.exact: Calculated from the minute on the birth certificate or family record.
notes.plusMinus15m: We scan 15 minutes either side and mark results that could change in that window.
notes.plusMinus1h: The Ascendant, houses, hour pillar, Zi Wei Life palace and some Energy Blueprint gates may change within these two hours — those results are marked.
notes.shichenOnly: Calculated at the middle of the double-hour; minute-level results (Ascendant, houses, some gates) are marked uncertain.
notes.unknown: You can still get a chart without the time: BaZi uses three pillars, Western skips houses and the Ascendant, and Zi Wei and the Energy Blueprint type need the hour — those parts are drawn dashed and explained.

place.label: Place of birth
place.noResults: Nothing found for “{query}”. You can enter coordinates instead.
place.tzNote: Historical time-zone changes and daylight saving come from the IANA database.
place.dataNote: Places from GeoNames (about 37,000 cities and counties, CC BY 4.0). Use coordinates if your town is missing.
place.loadFailed: The place list could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again, or enter coordinates.
place.required: Please choose a place of birth

sex.label: Sex for calculation
sex.note: BaZi luck-pillar direction and the Zi Wei chart need this; it is used only for calculation. If you skip, BaZi shows both luck directions and Zi Wei is not cast.

download.title: Daily awareness, in your pocket
download.lead: Daily energy weather, prompts, journal and widgets live in the app; deep reports, pair invitations and the pro workspace live on the web. One account, synced everywhere.

timeCertainty.label: Time certainty
timeCertainty.degradedNote: Parts that need the birth hour are shown dashed. Add your birth time and everything recalculates.

site.openApp: Have Armilla? Open in the App
site.afterInstall: After installing, come back here and tap “Open in the App” again.
site.orWeb: No need to install anything — you can fill it in right here.
site.inApp: This browser may not be able to open the app. Tap ··· at the top right and choose Open in Browser.
site.offline: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
site.keepInAppTitle: Keep this result in the app
site.keepInAppBody: Install Armilla and open the same result link there (or tap “Open in the App” below). Once you sign up, this pair reading appears under People. The result link works for 30 days.
site.dateKindNote: Four Pillars dates are converted in the app or on the web; here, please use the Gregorian or lunar calendar.
site.footerNote: Armilla describes tendencies and cycles for self-reflection. It does not predict events and is not a substitute for professional advice.
site.familyJoinBody: Joining a Family plan needs an Armilla account, so open this invitation in the app: tap the button below if Armilla is installed; otherwise get the app, sign in and tap the invitation link again. The link works once, for 7 days.
